map.草坪修剪高度推荐 使用指南: Lawn Mowing Height Recommendation User Guide
map.选择草种（如早熟禾、结缕草等 8 种）与季节，推荐最佳修剪留茬高度并给出不同季节: Choose a grass species (8 species such as Kentucky bluegrass and zoysiagrass) and a season, and the tool recommends the best cutting height plus mowing frequency and strategy per season. For garden lawn care, keeping turf healthy and dense.
map.按草种与季节查询适宜留茬高度，避免剪得太低灼伤根系或太高诱发病害。: Look up the suitable cutting height by grass species and season, avoiding cutting too low and burning the roots or too high and inviting disease.
map.遵循 1/3 原则安排修剪频次：每次剪去不超过当前草高的三分之一。: Follow the 1/3 rule when scheduling mowing: cut no more than one third of the current grass height each time.
map.按季节调整：夏季适当留高护根、冬季留高防寒、春秋生长季勤剪促分蘖。: Adjust by season: leave slightly taller in summer to protect roots, leave taller in winter against cold, and mow often in the spring and autumn growing seasons to encourage tillering.
map.留茬高度（春/夏/秋/冬，cm）: Cutting height (spring / summer / autumn / winter, cm)
map.：狗牙根 3/4/3/5；结缕草 3/4/3/5；高羊茅 5/6/5/6；圣奥古: : bermudagrass 3/4/3/5; zoysiagrass 3/4/3/5; tall fescue 5/6/5/6; St. Augustinegrass 5/6/5/7; bahiagrass 5/6/5/7; ryegrass 4/5/4/5; Kentucky bluegrass 4/5/4/5; centipedegrass 4/4/4/5. Seasonal points: mow once a week in the spring growth peak to encourage tillering; in summer heat leave 1-2 cm taller to protect roots and water less; in autumn mow every 10 days to build reserves for winter; in winter dormancy mow little and leave it taller against cold.
map.：高羊茅草坪夏季草长到 8 cm、目标留茬 6 cm：一次剪去 2 cm，占 8: : a tall fescue lawn at 8 cm in summer with a target height of 6 cm: cutting 2 cm at once is 25% of 8 cm, within the 1/3 rule so it can be done in one pass. If it has already reached 12 cm with a target of 6 cm, cutting 6 cm exceeds 1/3, so lower it in two passes several days apart, or large areas will yellow.
map.一次剪去过多叶片会大量损失光合面积、削弱根系，草坪发黄甚至死亡；分次逐步降低可让: Cutting too much leaf at once loses a large photosynthesizing area and weakens the root system, turning the lawn yellow or even killing it; lowering it gradually over several passes lets the lawn adapt and recover.
map.夏季为什么要留高一些？: Why leave it taller in summer?
map.较高的草层能遮阴土壤、降低地温、减少水分蒸发并抑制杂草萌发，帮助冷季型或暖季型草: A taller sward shades the soil, lowers ground temperature, reduces evaporation and suppresses weed germination, helping cool-season or warm-season lawns survive heat stress.
